test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The teacher said to Kavya, “You need a new notebook for English.”

options.text: The teacher told to Kavya that she needs a new notebook for English.
The teacher told Kavya that she needed a new notebook for English.
The teacher told Kavya that you needed a new notebook for English.
The teacher said to Kavya that you need a new notebook for English.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the** pronoun **and **tense** often change to maintain the original meaning.
 
• The pronoun **"you**" changes to "**she**" when referring to Kavya.
 
• The present tense "need" changes to the past tense "needed" in indirect speech.
 
• Therefore, "The teacher told Kavya that she needed a new notebook for English" is the correct indirect form.

Hence, the correct indirect form is '***The teacher told Kavya that she needed a new notebook for English*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech, personal pronouns and tense usually need to be adjusted.
 
• For example, if the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb in the reported speech typically shifts one tense back.
 
• Pronouns are changed to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• Example:
 
 
• Direct:** He said, "I am tired."**
 
• Indirect:** He said that he was tired.**
